user.title: Connect to MyEdenred Portugal
user.description: Enter the credentials you use in the MyEdenred Portugal portal. MyEdenred may send you a verification code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to MyEdenred Portugal
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {account} has expired. Continue to ask MyEdenred to send a new verification code.

reauth_credentials.title: Update the MyEdenred password
reauth_credentials.description: The stored password for {account} was rejected. Enter the account's current password.

mfa.title: Enter the MyEdenred verification code
mfa.description:
{challenge_message}

Enter the 5-digit code. Remaining resend attempts: {resend_tries}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the MyEdenred portal.
error.cannot_parse: Signed in successfully, but could not find the available balance.
error.cannot_resend: MyEdenred could not send another verification code. Cancel and restart reauthentication if the challenge has expired.
error.code_resent: A new verification code was sent.
error.invalid_code: Enter the valid 5-digit verification code sent by MyEdenred.

abort.unknown: The authentication flow is no longer active. Please start again.
abort.wrong_account: Reauthentication must use the same account.

init.title: MyEdenred Portugal options
init.description: Choose how often Home Assistant should refresh your MyEdenred balance. Optional session keep-alive sends a lightweight protected request with the stored token only; it may help with idle timeouts but cannot bypass an absolute server-side expiry.
